name: 2026 Fall — Catch, Footwork & Speed
goal: Fix the catch (elbows, knees, feet) and first-pull knee position before adding speed and lockout

phases.title: MESOCYCLE 1 — CATCH, FOOTWORK & FIRST-PULL POSITION
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–6 · 9/14–10/24 · Feet too wide on landing, knees out in catch, knees forward in the first pull (some athletes), split jerk footwork (light maintenance)

intent.title: Week 1 · 9/14–9/19
intent.text: Positions are rebuilt away from the floor first. No-feet snatch/clean forces a disciplined, narrow catch by removing foot movement entirely; muscle snatch/clean removes the leg re-bend that lets the knees-forward habit sneak in; paused deadlifts drill the knee-back reversal directly. No full lift from the floor yet.

exercises.name: Snatch Deadlift (pause below knee)
exercises.note: Pause, then consciously reverse the knees back before continuing — this is the knees-forward fix

exercises.name: No-Feet Snatch
exercises.note: Feet stay in the pull stance the whole rep — no jump, no reset — this is the landing-width fix

exercises.name: Snatch Balance
exercises.note: Land soft, same footprint as start — no stepping out

exercises.name: Muscle Snatch
exercises.note: No leg re-bend — forces correct knee/hip sequencing instead of a floor pull

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Knees out through the whole rep

intent.title: Week 5 · 10/12–10/17 · Checkpoint Week
intent.text: Full snatch/clean from the floor returns for the first time this block, now that the knee pattern and catch width have been grooved away from the floor. No-feet work opens the session as a final reminder before the full lift. This week is a checkpoint, not a max-out — watch feet, knees, and first-pull knee direction if you can get it on video.

exercises.name: No-Feet Snatch
exercises.note: Last footwork reminder before the full lift

exercises.name: Snatch Balance
exercises.note: Land soft, same footprint

exercises.name: Muscle Snatch
exercises.note: Maintains the knee/hip sequencing under the full lift

exercises.name: Snatch (full lift, floor start)
exercises.note: First floor pull of the block — knees back off the floor, feet and knees live

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Knees out through the whole rep

phases.title: MESOCYCLE 2 — SPEED & LOCKOUT
phases.subtitle: Weeks 7–12 · 10/26–12/5 · Speed above the knee, clean catch elbows, snatch lockout (feet width, knee tracking, split jerk feet as light maintenance)

intent.title: Week 7 · 10/26–10/31
intent.text: Speed above the knee and snatch lockout become the priority. Pull work stays off the floor (hang, above the knee) so the speed cue doesn't drag the knees-forward habit back in. No-feet snatch/clean becomes the single warmup piece carrying the feet/knee maintenance cue.

exercises.name: No-Feet Snatch (maintenance)
exercises.note: Feet stay in the pull stance — maintenance only, not a focus piece anymore

exercises.name: Heaving Snatch Balance
exercises.note: Push the floor away, shrug into the bar — active lockout

exercises.name: Muscle Snatch
exercises.note: Maintenance for knee/hip sequencing

exercises.name: Snatch Pull (above knee, speed)
exercises.note: Jump, don't muscle — violent extension once past the knee

exercises.name: Hang Snatch (above knee)
exercises.note: Same speed cue as the pull, into a narrow landing

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Maintenance knee-out cue only

exercises.name: No-Feet Clean (maintenance)
exercises.note: Feet stay in the pull stance — maintenance only, not a focus piece anymore

exercises.name: Muscle Clean
exercises.note: Elbows up and around — whip, not muscle up

exercises.name: Clean Pull (above knee, speed)
exercises.note: Jump, don't muscle — violent extension once past the knee

exercises.name: Hang Clean (above knee)
exercises.note: Elbow speed carries from the muscle clean work

exercises.name: Split Jerk
exercises.note: Maintenance — front heel down first

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Maintenance knee-out cue only

intent.title: Week 11 · 11/23–11/28 · Checkpoint Week
intent.text: Full lifts from the floor carry every cue at once. This week closes the cycle — treat it as a technique checkpoint across all seven faults, not a max-out day.

exercises.name: Tall Snatch (2s overhead hold)
exercises.note: Active lockout check before the lift goes heavy

exercises.name: Snatch (full lift, floor start, all cues live)
exercises.note: Feet, knees (both catch and first pull), speed, and lockout together

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Maintenance knee-out cue only

exercises.name: Tall Clean (strict elbow finish)
exercises.note: Elbow position check before the lift goes heavy

exercises.name: Clean & Jerk (full lift, floor start, all cues live)
exercises.note: Feet, knees, elbows, and lockout together

exercises.name: Back Squat
